title: Old Bay Tuna Spread
description: The flavor of Old Bay seasoning goes well with the tuna and cream cheese combination in this easy-to-make spread that guests will love to dip crackers, chips, or veggies in.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) package low-fat cream cheese, softened
2 tablespoons minced sweet onion (such as Vidalia®)
2 tablespoons capers - rinsed, drained, and chopped
1 teaspoon reduced-sodium seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
3 drops hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco®), or more to taste

steps.text: Whip cream cheese in a bowl with an electric hand mixer. Add onion, capers, lemon zest and juice, seafood seasoning, parsley, Worcestershire, and hot sauce. Mix well. Add tuna and mix until well blended.
Refrigerate for 2 hours, or up to overnight.
